highlights: Approved full purchase refunds and chargebacks revoke Pro at the next online refresh. New Pro choices require confirmation within 30 days for paid licences or three days for trials. Existing work and output remain available.

Desktop Free reopens this computer's saved Pro work for settings edits. Imported Pro work and artwork changes ask for Pro; older unsealed projects need Pro once. Trials use a one-way firmware code to recognise repeat use.

KerfDesk Design Studio brings photo and vector work into one workspace. Individual traced lines and shapes can be selected and edited directly, with better Trim tangencies and curve-preserving Close Path.
Offline multilingual text shaping, Photoshop composite import and advanced nesting add more design options. Phone & MCP controls are now in the main toolbar with a live status panel.

Licence purchases recover saved Paddle orders more reliably and work on www and older browsers. Console coordinate changes refresh machine evidence, and exported G-code comments exclude realtime control bytes.

Saved material recipes retain their effective linked settings. Import progress and cancellation stay consistent during overlapping file opens, and recovery messages give clearer guidance when saved work is unavailable.
